title: A/R Summary sorts accented customer names with their base letter
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have six customers with open invoices on today's date, named "Eagle" (customer A), "Émile's" (customer B), "Emma" (customer C), "Fargo" (customer D), "Øster" (customer E) and "Ozone" (customer F). Customer B and customer E start with a capital accented letter.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Without clicking any column header, find the six customers in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • All six customers are listed, reading from top to bottom customer A, customer B, customer C, customer D, customer E, customer F.
  • "Émile's" sorts among the E names (between "Eagle" and "Emma"), not after the Z names.
  • "Øster" sorts as an O, before "Ozone".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-R1: “A/R Summary opens with customers in name order, A to Z; A/P Summary opens with vendors in name order, A to Z.”
  • S1-R3: “Accented letters sort with their base letter: "Émile's" sorts among the E names (é è ê ë sort as e, á à â ä ã å as a, ç as c, ñ as n, ö ó ò ô õ ø as o, ü ú ù û as u, í ì î ï as i, ý ÿ as y, ß as ss, æ as ae, œ as oe, in both cases).”
